// REQ: LANG-1601 LANG-1602 LANG-1603 LANG-1604
/* Block comment */
shared class Greeter(shared String name = "world") {
    shared String greet(Integer times = 1) {
        variable value text = "Hello, ``name``!\n";
        for (i in 1..times) { print(text); }
        return text;
    }
}
shared void run() {
    value g = Greeter("ceylon");
    Character c = 'x';
    if (exists n = g.name, n.size > 0 && true) {
        print(g.greet(#1F));
    }
}
